requirements.file_location: Type-alias support belongs in the existing Python-domain component.
requirements.api_contract: Provide the py:type directive and role, optional alias annotation, indexing, and cross-reference behavior consistent with other Python objects.
requirements.extension_registration: The Python domain registers the object type, directive, and cross-reference role.
requirements.extension_point_adherence: Use PyObject, the existing annotation parser, and Python-domain cross-reference machinery rather than a separate rendering path.
requirements.convention_fit: Follow Python-domain naming, validation, error, documentation and test conventions. The original contributing guide (doc/internals/contributing.rst:114-115,155) requires appropriate unit tests for new features. A patch with no automated test changes fails this criterion; documentation examples alone are not regression tests. Added tests must meaningfully exercise the new directive/role and match local test style; exact reference test names are not required.
requirements.requirement_intent: Users can document and cross-reference type aliases, including module-level and nested aliases, with optional alias expressions. Preserve existing Python-domain behavior.

requirements.file_location: Percentile computation belongs in the statistics layer and is exported through seaborn.objects.
requirements.api_contract: Perc accepts an integer number of evenly spaced percentiles or an explicit percentile list, plus an interpolation method, and implements the existing Stat call contract.
requirements.extension_registration: Expose Perc through seaborn.objects so it composes with Plot.add.
requirements.extension_point_adherence: Use the Stat abstraction and existing GroupBy, orientation, and scale conventions rather than a standalone plotting implementation.
requirements.convention_fit: Follow existing Stat naming, validation, error handling, documentation and test style. Added or modified tests must match local patterns. This pilot does not require a new test addition for this task; unchanged tests retain their existing style. Do not infer a mandatory addition solely from reference-only test files. Candidate-owned changed tests and the fixed reference regression checks must execute successfully.
requirements.requirement_intent: Percentiles work for both orientations, grouped data, missing values, and interpolation choices, preserving the objects plotting API.
